craft_notes: Sthāyin: lone-a (the syllable-climax: no drop, no emission — only a). Rows: row 2 (rises→flood). Close: Lord (parameśvara — highest noun of the block; the a-syllable names the Lord by rising). Rejected: 'a-kāra as Brahman' — killed: Lord kept; 'sometimes' — killed: sudden kept (sahasā).

lines: No drop, no emission: lone a-syllable great:
rises, Goddess, sudden — knowledge-flood, highest Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: abindum avisargaṃ ca akāraṃ japato mahān | udeti devi sahasā jñānaughaḥ parameśvaraḥ

reads_against.argmap: What rises from the a-syllable? → The lone a-syllable suddenly rises into knowledge-flood — the Lord.
c1_essence: No drop, no emission: lone a rises, knowledge-flood.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with adbhuta (stillness startled by its own gates)
